{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Hero Ferrari — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Hero Ferrari]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Hero Ferrari]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Hero Ferrari]]'s Engineer services in Siris.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Hero Ferrari is '''common knowledge''' and does not require a referral from another Engineer.
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement for Hero Ferrari.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Settlement Defence Plans'''
Settlement Defence Plans are an Odyssey '''Data''' material.

Current material data lists them as obtainable from:

* '''Irregular Markers''' points of interest;
* data ports in '''CMD buildings'''; and
* '''mission rewards'''.

Because Settlement Defence Plans are Data rather than a ship commodity, they do '''not''' require cargo-rack capacity.

{{Tip|Only five plans are now required. Before following an older farming guide built around collecting 15, check whether you already have enough in your Odyssey material storage.}}

Once the five plans have been provided to Hero, [[Wellington Beck]] becomes the next Engineer in this branch.

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Find a system with an active ground conflict.
# Visit a station or settlement with Frontline Solutions.
# Choose a surface conflict zone.
# Travel to the conflict zone using the Frontline Solutions dropship or your own transport.
# Choose a side and complete the battle.
# Repeat until you have completed '''10 surface conflict zones'''.
# Travel to '''Nevermore Terrace''' on '''Siris 5 c'''.
# Access Hero Ferrari's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Hero Ferrari]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
